t: You are looking at the University of Westminster, a public university that began in 1838 as the Royal Polytechnic Institution, the first polytechnic to open in London. It received its Royal charter in August 1839, and became the University of Westminster in 1992. Quintin Hogg, a merchant and philanthropist, is remembered as the founder. He is chiefly known as a benefactor of the Royal Polytechnic institution on Regent Street, which is why his name is so closely tied to this place and to the university it became.
